st: Gifts and ads aside, what does Christmas teach us?

sec.t: ff.79.1 Shrek Crocs and other ogres
sec.p: Let's kick off this newsletter, which will preach minimalism, with a list of last-minute gifts. Because I'm consistent like that.

sec.t: ff.79.2 The ecology and economics of Christmas trees
sec.p: We've talked about trees elsewhere (🎼 ff.33 Will plants save us?).
It's not Christmas without the themed ads. For a director, making John Lewis's (the British equivalent of La Rinascente) is like winning an Oscar.
Unwrapping the year. Thanks in part to Spotify Wrapped, Christmas and the end of the year come with a renewed bout of introspection. More and more, a moment to stop and take stock.
